title: Realistic tape, natural-colour dither, wider controls
description: Make the camcorder look like real analog video rather than pixelated digital, let dither keep natural colours with many more styles, palettes and sizes, and give bend six knobs - none of which can freeze the picture.

clauses.text: Camcorder frames are an analog picture - 320 samples across by 480 lines (240 by 640 held upright), shown and saved at 4:3 with smooth, not blocky, scaling.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "camcorder frames are analog shaped and saved smooth" passes

clauses.text: The tape looks like tape: blacks are lifted grey not pure black, whites roll off softly, bright lights glow into their surroundings, and grain is heavier in the shadows than in the highlights.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "blacks lift and whites roll off", "bright lights glow" and "grain is heavier in shadows" pass

clauses.text: Dither can keep natural colours: a natural palette with N levels per channel has N cubed colours, and dithering an orange stays orange on average while using only palette colours.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "natural colour dither keeps the colour" passes

clauses.text: The dither knobs reach every algorithm, at least twelve colour choices (natural ones included), six pixel sizes from 320 down to 64 wide, and a contrast knob that changes the result.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "dither knobs reach every option" passes

clauses.text: Bend has six knobs - NOISE, TEAR, COLOUR, MEMORY, ROLL, BLOCKS. All at zero leaves the picture alone; each alone changes it and more is stronger; MEMORY never freezes the picture at any size.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "six bend knobs each get stronger" and "memory bend never freezes the picture" pass

cases.description: default settings are 320x480 (portrait 240x640) with a 4:3 / 3:4 display shape; the saved photo is 1280x960 and a horizontal ramp has no 4-pixel flat runs
noiseless VHS: pure black comes out as luma 10-30, pure white below 245
a white square on black brightens pixels 3 px outside it compared with bloom off
noise-only VHS: luma spread on a dark flat frame exceeds 1.3x that on a bright one
natural(4) has 64 colours; a flat orange through Bayer and Floyd-Steinberg averages within 8 per channel and stays in palette
style knob hits all 12 algorithms, colour knob >= 12 palettes incl. natural, pixel knob 6 sizes 320..64, contrast 0 vs 1 differ
all zero is neutral; each of the six alone differs from the input at 0.3 and more at 1.0
at every frame size, with MEMORY at 0.2 and 1.0, a changed input still changes the output within a few frames
